title: Thu 29 Oct 2026: Fed holds with two hawkish dissents, quiet Budget, ECB decision today, private markets gating spreads
summary: The Federal Reserve holds rates in a ten to two vote with two officials wanting a hike, Wall Street rises for a third day, and gilts and sterling shrug off Chancellor John Healey's quiet first Budget. We preview this afternoon's European Central Bank decision, cover new FCA consultations on financial crime and the Senior Managers regime, a timetable for transaction reporting, and EU and US developments. In funds, gating spreads from private credit into private equity; plus three COO action points and the diary for the week.
